# Floating tables in section-column previews

These six original DOCX controls are generated by
`tools/floating_column_recovery_fixture.py`. Their two pictures are original
Pillow geometry authored in that script. No corpus artwork, font binaries,
standards schemas, or third-party document engine are redistributed.

Each paired document has two equal-width columns, Arial text, formatted cells,
two pictures, an inline healthy table, a header, and a PAGE-field footer. The
unsupported member adds floating positioning to a table before healthy content,
after it, or at both locations. Positioning uses a 12pt horizontal and 6pt
vertical offset. The matched member places those tables inline at column start.
All six ZIPs reproduce byte-for-byte with the recorded local generator runtime.

The supported target is **localized read-only recovery**, not floating-table
layout equivalence. Strict validation still rejects floating tables in column flow.
The preview places each affected table inline at column start, discloses that
approximation, and retains the source's original floating declaration and bytes.
Alignment/indent derived from floating coordinates cannot leak into that inline
layout. Existing floating tables outside column flow retain their behavior.

Unit tests check strict rejection, retained cells and stories, unchanged source
state, exact layout correspondence, and matched-document edit/export/undo.
Browser tests require exact geometry and complete-page pixel identity with the
matched control at 75% and 100%, including failures before and after healthy
content and multiple failures. They enforce read-only input and byte-exact
original download. No raster or geometry tolerance was loosened.

The reference application opened both final `before` controls as one Letter page. Their
complete native pages and the preview were inspected. The floating reference
correctly wraps text around the table; the inline reference documents the
disclosed approximation. Native PDFs remain private because they contain font
subsets.

Specification: ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.4.57 (`tblpPr`) and §§17.6.3–17.6.4
(`col`, `cols`). This change claims no new reference/spec divergence. Full floating
positioning/wrapping in columns and recovery of square-wrapped column drawings
remain open.
